results.title: Things you should never keep near a gas stove and why
results.description: Everyday kitchen items around gas stoves can become dangerous fire hazards. Plastic bags, containers, and cleaning supplies may melt or ignite near flames, while towels and paper products are also at risk. It’s essential to store flammable items like cooking oils away from heat sources. Maintaining a clutter-free space around your stove is crucial to preventing any cooking-related fires.
